note: Links from Marble micro-topics to Alberta curriculum outcomes (keys into curriculum-standards.json, slugs ab-*). Kept separate from topics.json so upstream updates merge cleanly. fit=direct: the Alberta outcome states the idea; fit=partial: it covers part of it or a close variant.
method: Each topic was compared against the full text of Alberta outcomes for grades K–9 in the matching subject (Mathematics, English Language Arts, Science, Social Studies, Physical Education & Wellness, Health & Life Skills, Career Education & Financial Literacy) by Claude, reading each outcome with its knowledge, understanding and skills statements. Links are machine-made and unreviewed by a teacher.
